_note: Manual rule trial (v0). Human/AI-applied rules, NOT executed screening code. evidence.type: aic_text = verbatim AIC description; visual_obs = machine observation of the image (not AIC fact); inference = interpretation without direct evidence.
title: The Dream of Paris

evidence.quote: His sleeping pose and the painting’s inscription ... indicate that he is in the midst of a dream vision
choosing the fairest goddess among Minerva, Juno, and Venus

referents.label: Future events: departure of Paris and Helen, Trojan War

evidence.quote: used to foreshadow future events ... the departure of Paris and Helen by boat in the middle distance, the catalyst for the Trojan War
emphasizes the enduring relevance of his moral crossroads

operations.carrier: sleeping knight (eyes closed, head on hand) surrounded by goddesses

evidence.note: central standing figure with closed eyes, cheek resting on hand; nude figures arranged on both sides

operations.carrier: paper slip on tree: PARIS / TRA(U)M

evidence.quote: the painting’s inscription, PARIS / TRA(U)M (“dream of Paris,” on the slip of paper attached to the tree)

evidence.note: white slip on central trunk, on the vertical axis directly above the sleeper's head

evidence.quote: the golden apple given as a prize in the contest

evidence.note: heart = love is conventional; description does not state it

operations.carrier: small boat with figures in middle distance

evidence.quote: foreshadow future events ... by boat in the middle distance

evidence.note: boat with figures on the lake behind the central tree; foreground = dream present, background = future

evidence.quote: wears the garb of a contemporary knight rather than classical dress, a choice that emphasizes the enduring relevance of his moral crossroads

unexplained_visual_observations.note: Second male figure in helmet and red cloak holding a staff beside Paris. Not identified in the AIC description; NOT assigned an identity.
Cupid aims a bow/arrow upward toward the central figures. Description only says 'frolicking'.
Central tree trunk splits the panel vertically; inscription, sleeper and dropped helmets align on it.

rule_revisions_suggested: Referents need nesting (R1 dream contains R2 goddesses and R3 future), not a flat list.
Vocabulary lacks a TIME dimension: add DEPTH_AS_TIME (foreshadowing) and ANACHRONISM as candidate operations.
Evidence must carry a type (aic_text / visual_obs / inference) and confidence; low-confidence inferences should not enter the score by default.
